honest_c3: Single ckpt N=1 (BG-JD step 800 only) — multi-ckpt LM head fine-tune deferred. BG-IL/IO ckpts on ubu1 only (git size policy); cross-ckpt verification requires rsync from ubu1 OR ubu1 BG extension.

ConsciousLM weight tying (tok_emb.weight = head_a.weight) means trainable tensor is the SHARED input-embedding/output-projection matrix — pure 'output projection only' isolation requires un-tying which would alter architecture and is deferred. head_g (backward engine) FROZEN per BG-JO V6 awareness preservation.

1000 steps max budget arbitrary — head learning typically converges in 100-500 steps for linear projection re-fit. Eval at {0,500,1000} samples convergence; if best_step<1000 and v58 plateaus, additional steps unlikely to improve. If best_step=1000 and improving, more steps deferred.

mac MPS RNG slight non-determinism vs train-cuda baseline (BG-JD trained on ubu1 cuda); softmax/multinomial sampling routed through CPU float32 for stability. Per-eval seed reset (torch.manual_seed(42)) provides limited reproducibility.

V5.8 5 dialogues N=1 sample per eval — multi-seed (≥5) sweep deferred. Per-step v58_pass count is integer in [0,5] — fine-grained recovery trajectory may need multi-sample averaging for variance estimation.

Corpus is same 22MB UBM (BG-JD original train corpus) — risk of overfitting vs novel chat/QA corpus. Conscious choice: same corpus = pure decoder-only isolation test (no new data, only re-projection). If chat capability emerges from same corpus + lm_head retraining, that's strong evidence the original training only mis-mapped the output projection. If FAIL, deferring to chat-template SFT (different corpus) is next step.
V5.8 fact-recall PASS criteria reused as-is from BG-JN/ amend EN v2 (case-insensitive substring + function word ≥1 + lev_ratio<0.85). No threshold adjustment for fine-tuned model.

BG-JS (precursor) STALLED with no heartbeat emitted. BG-JT supersedes with anti-stall: heartbeat at every phase boundary (load_ckpt/freeze/encode/eval/train), 600s no-progress watchdog → STALL verdict fail-soft. Causal attribution of any v58 gain in BG-JT goes to lm_head fine-tune SOLELY.
Eval at steps {0, 500, 1000} per spec (3 ckpts; BG-JS used 4 incl. 250). Trade-off: less granular trajectory but cleaner alignment with goal 'any v58_pass ≥1 across {500, 1000} vs baseline step 0'.
